auth.token_lifetime: Access token expires_in is returned with each token (value not fixed in docs)
auth.refresh: offline_access scope returns a rotating refresh token; exchange at https://auth.atlassian.com/oauth/token; expires after 90 days of inactivity, each use issues a new one and invalidates the old (10-minute reuse interval)

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Distribution (Marketplace/sharing) not started; app is private (status file)
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Jira site admin or user consents to the LOVELEEDAY app and selects the Atlassian site; access equals that user's permissions.
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Immediate for a private app; sharing/distribution review UNVERIFIED

sandbox.how_to_get: UNVERIFIED (free Atlassian Jira site can be created for testing; not confirmed in status file)

rate_limits: Points-based hourly quota: 65,000 points/hour global pool by default; per-tenant pool (100,000+10 x users Standard, 130,000+20 x users Premium, 150,000+30 x users Enterprise, cap 500,000) only for apps granted it; per-endpoint burst GET 100/s, POST 100/s, PUT 50/s, DELETE 50/s; 429 with Retry-After
incremental_sync: UNVERIFIED (JQL 'updated >=' search with pagination; not fetched)
blockers: Only ONE 3LO callback URL allowed; only the portal callback is registered (no localhost).
Status probe is not discriminating (same 400/403 for real and wrong secrets); credentials unproven beyond the console.
